title: Jackson Juggernaut ET7 | Seven strings, one equilibrium

subject.summary: Exact-model reconstruction of Jackson Pro Plus Signature Misha Mansoor Juggernaut ET7, model 2914017554. Asymmetric body and compact AT-1 4x3 headstock traced from official front/back photographs; documented 26.5-inch scale, 24 frets, HH MM1 electronics and EverTune F7. Image-derived geometry remains inferred, not factory CAD.

facts.value: Nut u=2398; saddle break u=350; tail datum u=25; centerline v=449+(u-350)*25/2048.
facts.note: Visual pixel estimates on 3000 x 895 photo; scale 673.1/2048 mm per pixel. De-skewed to neck centerline. Not metrology.

facts.value: Hand-traced asymmetric double cutaway: long bass horn, shorter hooked treble horn, concave waist and rounded skewed lower bout.
facts.note: All outline coordinates inferred from official front photo; 1-4 mm visual uncertainty; no manufacturer outline coordinates found.
Approximate measured 895-pixel lower bout at calibration scale; not a factory specification.
Section estimate consistent with oblique photographs and usual F7 installation; not a Jackson dimension.

facts.value: Continuous chamfer around the front and rear, broad outer bouts and horn cutaways.
facts.note: Bevel width changes inferred visually; contour is schematic, not factory CAD.

facts.value: Compact wedge AT-1 with curved nut flare, oblique 4-post edge and swept pointed tip.
facts.note: Polygon and post centers traced from headstock crop [2360,260,3000,650]; no claimed headstock angle specification.

facts.value: Taper from 44.45 mm nut to approximately 63 mm at fret 24; rounded back, shallow heel transition.
facts.note: Taper and back section inferred; board face follows documented 508 mm radius.

facts.value: Neck pickup u=768; bridge pickup u=496; volume (398,703); tone (240,742); switch endpoints (455,750)-(547,675).
facts.note: Original front image pixel estimates. Physical Y increases with image u; X follows de-skewed image v. Pickup sizes and heights inferred.

facts.value: Rear EverTune plate, seven string-access slots, larger asymmetric electronics cover on treble lower bout and four recessed heel screws.
facts.note: Back image is mirrored to align front; dimensions and locations visually estimated; no hidden spring mechanism invented.
Mathematical reconstruction from documented scale and observed straight frets; manufacturing offsets not measured.

facts.value: Treble-edge dots at 3,5,7,9; double 12; bass-edge 15,17,19,21; double treble-edge 24.
facts.note: Direct visual observation of exact front photo, including crossover after fret 12.

facts.value: Illustrative slow control demonstration: volume rotation, tone pull and turn, selector pivot; no tremolo and no rotating fixed bridge.
facts.note: Motion ranges and timing chosen for presentation, not measured kinematics. Guitar at rest remains assembled.
